messages.text: Checking on my repair ticket for my Bitfortun BS-1
Handed to the team · RMA approval for a drop-shipped BS-1 is a person's call; order carries no rma-ap

Checked it just now. Your BS-1 return (it sits on order Shop····, the one from September) is still waiting on approval, five days after Hal wrote the fault up. That wait is on us and I'm sorry.

I've pushed it to the team again and they're on until 6pm ET today. Stay in the chat if you can and one of them will come in here, otherwise the answer reaches your email.

Keep the unit unplugged and boxed if you still have the packaging.
Unit is unplugged and boxed for shipment

Perfect, that's everything ready on your side. Don't send it anywhere yet though: the return needs the approval and a prepaid label with a reference number written on the box, otherwise the warehouse can't match it when it lands.

The team has it now and they're on until 6pm ET. As soon as it's approved I'll post the label and the reference right here, and it also goes to your email.

Just looked again, nothing new on the order yet, so the approval hasn't come through. No label and no reference number to give you until it does, and I won't tell you one is on its way before I have it.

The team is on until 6pm ET today. They have your case in front of them and the answer comes here or to your email either way. Sorry you're having to chase it.
